channel.description: WSJ World News RSS, without Opinions

item.title: A Mystery Businessman Introduced Jensen Huang to His Paramour. It Was Her Husband.
item.description: Kang Wei appeared to accept that his wife Alice Huang was in a romantic relationship and spoke openly of her closeness to the Nvidia chief.

item.title: Ukraine Says Its Military Starlink Is Disrupted Again, Hurting Defenses
item.description: Drones that rely on Starshield, a military version of SpaceX’s Starlink service, are losing connectivity if they fly faster than 100 miles an hour.

item.title: Israel Strikes Gaza Hospital, Killing at Least Six
item.description: The attack targeted Hamas militants, according to the Israeli military, and comes as progress on Trump’s Gaza Peace Plan is stalled.

item.title: Huang’s Coziness With Trump Wasn’t Enough to Save Him From Spying Scandal
item.description: U.S. officials have repeatedly raised concerns about his influence with the president and the Nvidia CEO’s posture toward China.

item.title: Oil Prices Rebound as Trump Questions Need for Iran Deal
item.description: Oil prices rebounded from initial declines as investors assessed the prospects for renewed U.S.-Iran negotiations after Trump said Washington no longer needed an agreement with Tehran.

item.title: Best High-Yield Savings Accounts of November 2026: Up to 5.00%
item.description: Beat average interest rates with one of these top high-yield savings accounts.

item.title: This Shipping Lane Is Now the World’s Deadliest. It Isn’t Hormuz.
item.description: Fatal attacks in the Black Sea have jumped, disrupting trade routes and posing a new test for NATO.

item.title: The ‘Peruvian Pope’ Returns Home to Elation
item.description: Chicago-born Pope Leo XIV spent two decades ministering in Peru, where citizens are welcoming him with a 45-foot statue, murals and T-shirts bearing his likeness.

item.title: The Spread of Cheaper Ballistic Missiles Rips Up Decades of Military Thinking
item.description: As interceptor supplies run down, Iran and the Houthis have shown how American bases are increasingly vulnerable.

item.title: Bessent Moved to Military Base After Threats Linked to Iran
item.description: The Treasury secretary has led the administration’s economic pressure campaign against Tehran.

item.title: JD Vance Emerges as Lead Iran Negotiator
item.description: Plus, Democrats are pointing fingers after Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth avoided impeachment, and United Airlines will ban AI bots from booking its flights.

item.title: The Global Economy Looks Vulnerable to an AI Bust
item.description: Some countries, particularly in Asia, are seen as heavily exposed to the U.S. data-center build-out.

item.title: Vance Considers Direct Talks With Iran Hard-Liner in Push to End War
item.description: Becoming the face of Iran diplomacy could be politically risky for the vice president, some U.S. officials say.

item.title: Spain Hit by General Strike as Cost of Living Takes Center Stage Ahead of Elections
item.description: Demonstrators took to the streets of cities across Spain to join the country’s first general strike in 14 years, calling for measures to tackle the rising cost of living weeks before voters head to the polls.

item.title: The Morning Risk Report: How Hackers Steal Millions in AI Computing Power
item.description: Plus: Jensen Huang affair revives push for chip restrictions and the U.S. has sued Lyft.

item.title: EU Takes Aim at Influencer Marketing, Deceptive Online Tactics With Revamped Rules
item.description: The European Union proposed new legislation to tighten its online consumer protection rules, targeting deceptive designs, influencer marketing and artificial intelligence.

item.title: Jensen Huang Affair Strains Taiwan’s Devotion to Its Hometown Hero
item.description: The Nvidia CEO’s affair has shaken Taiwan, his birthplace and a cornerstone of the AI chip industry he helped create.

item.title: Trump’s Plan to Import Russian Diesel Stalls on the High Seas
item.description: Several fuel tankers bound for the U.S. shifted course following difficulties finding buyers willing to accept the cargoes.

item.title: BOE Should Raise Key Rate to Around 5%, U.K. Economic Think Tank Says
item.description: Bank of England policymakers were set to move too slowly, the National Institute of Economic and Social Research said, urging them to raise the key rate to around 5% to tame inflation within three years.

item.title: Canada PM Carney Calls Stellantis Factory Sale ‘Unacceptable’
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said he’s prepared to use whatever legal and policy levers available to protect the roughly 2,000 workers affected.
